errors.description: The turned-back cuff vent corner renders with a pale cream underside, reading as a contrast underlay. The line drawing specifies the turned-back corner but assigns it no colour.
errors.expected: Turned-back vent corner at the cuff hem, colour unspecified by the drawing.
errors.actual: Turned-back vent corner present, but its exposed face is a light cream tone against the navy hopsack.
errors.correction: If regenerated, render the vent corner underside in self cloth rather than a contrasting pale tone.

notes: Four level buttonholes in a vertical column beside the cuff vent, exactly as drawn. Red marks in the blueprint correctly interpreted as highlights, not colour. Straight-vs-slanted distinction is unmistakable within one second.
